statement: let block := fun x : ℕ => Finset.Ioc x (2*x); let pp := fun x : ℕ => ∑ n ∈ (block x).filter (fun n => ¬ Nat.Prime (n^2+1)), ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt (n^2+1); ∀ ε : ℝ, 0<ε → ∃ X : ℕ, ∀ x ≥ X, pp x ≤ ε*x

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然扩张 · QP-0067 · 把二次序列上真幂的 Mangoldt 质量压到 o(x)
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH and natural extensions · QP-0067 · Bound the proper-power Mangoldt mass by o(x)

brief.zh: 计数乘以单个素数幂的 O(log x) 权，x^{2/3}log²x=o(x)。
brief.en: Multiply the count by the O(log x) weight per power and absorb x^{2/3}log²x into εx.
